display_title: How Do You Know My Oppa
description:
Hyo-eun, the main character, witnesses her ex-boyfriend and college junior dumping her on the street, and in a fit of rage, drinks with the brother next door and wakes up the next day in bed with him. Hyo-eun, who wants to do something that has never happened, actively confronts Hyo-eun, and Jae-ha Jae-ha, the older brother next door, skillfully seduces Hyo-eun?
